Mixpanel pricing starts with a generous free plan offering up to 1 million events per month . If you need more, the Growth plan charges roughly $0.00028 per event after that threshold. Enterprise? Expect custom pricing that can run into tens of thousands annually.
If that sounds steep for your needs, Seline offers a simpler, more affordable alternative. It starts free and then just $14/month when you grow.
How did we arrive at this conclusion? Let's break down Mixpanel pricing in detail:
How much does Mixpanel cost? Is Mixpanel free? Which Mixpanel pricing plan should I go for?
If you're asking any of these questions, you're probably evaluating product analytics tools for your business. Whether you're:
A startup trying to understand user behavior on a tight budget
A growing company debating whether Mixpanel pricing fits your budget as you scale
An enterprise looking for robust analytics with custom requirements
Understanding Mixpanel pricing is crucial before you commit. Let's dive into everything you need to know.
How Much Does Mixpanel Cost?
Mixpanel pricing is built around an event-based model . Every user action you track (a click, a signup, a purchase) counts as an event. The more events you track, the more you pay.
Here's the breakdown of Mixpanel pricing tiers:
Good news if you're just getting started: Mixpanel pricing includes a free tier that's surprisingly capable.
Mixpanel's product analytics dashboard.
The free plan includes:
Up to 1 Million Monthly Events: That's a decent allowance for small apps and websites. An "event" is any tracked user interaction, so keep in mind that active users can generate many events.
Core Analytics Reports: You get access to funnels, retention analysis, and flows. The essentials for understanding user behavior.
Limited Session Replays: Around 10,000 session replays per month to see exactly how users interact with your product.
5 Saved Reports Per User: Enough to get started, but teams might quickly feel constrained.
But Mixpanel pricing on the free tier does come with limitations:
Hard Event Cap: Once you hit 1 million events, you'll need to upgrade or stop tracking.
Limited Saved Reports: Only 5 per user can be restrictive for collaborative teams.
Basic Features Only: Advanced features like behavioral cohorts, unlimited reports, and group analytics require paid plans.
The free plan works well for early-stage projects, MVPs, or testing the waters. But if your product gains traction, you'll quickly feel the squeeze of Mixpanel pricing constraints.
This is where Mixpanel pricing gets interesting, and potentially expensive.
The Growth plan still includes your first 1 million events free each month. After that, you pay per event. Current Mixpanel pricing for additional events is approximately $0.00028 per event (or about $0.28 per 1,000 events).
Sounds cheap? Let's do some quick math on Mixpanel pricing:
5 million events/month: ~$1,120/month
10 million events/month: ~$2,520/month
50 million events/month: ~$13,720/month
As you can see, Mixpanel pricing scales quickly with usage.
What you get with Growth:
Unlimited Saved Reports: No more caps on collaborative analytics.
Behavioral Cohorts: Segment users based on actions they've taken (or haven't).
Expanded Session Replays: Up to 20,000+ replays per month.
Formulas and Custom Metrics: Build advanced calculations on your data.
Better Data Governance: More control over your analytics setup.
But here's the catch with Mixpanel pricing at this level. It doesn't include everything:
Group Analytics: Essential for B2B products tracking account-level behavior? That's an add-on.
Data Pipelines: Want to export data to your warehouse? Extra cost.
Warehouse Connectors: Another add-on for the Mixpanel pricing total.
These add-ons can significantly increase what you pay beyond the base Mixpanel pricing.
For organizations with serious requirements, Mixpanel pricing goes custom.
Enterprise includes everything in Growth, plus:
Unlimited Event Volume: Custom contracts based on your actual usage.
Advanced Security and Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA eligibility, SSO, and more.
Dedicated Support: Priority access to Mixpanel's team.
Custom Data Retention: Keep your data longer than standard limits.
Advanced Permissions: Granular access controls for large teams.
Mixpanel pricing for Enterprise isn't published, but based on industry reports, expect anywhere from $25,000 to $100,000+ per year depending on your event volume and feature requirements.
When evaluating Mixpanel pricing, don't forget about these extras:
Implementation Costs: Setting up proper event tracking requires engineering time. Complex implementations might need consultants.
Training: Mixpanel has a learning curve. Your team will need time to master it.
Add-On Features: Group Analytics, Data Pipelines, and other advanced features come at additional Mixpanel pricing.
Overage Charges: Unexpectedly high traffic month? Your Mixpanel pricing bill could spike.
Mixpanel pricing can deliver value if you need deep product analytics. It excels at:
Tracking user journeys through complex funnels
Understanding retention patterns
Segmenting users based on behavior
A/B testing and experimentation
But for many businesses, especially those focused on marketing analytics, website traffic, and simpler use cases, Mixpanel pricing can feel like overkill.
The event-based model means your costs grow with success. The more users you have, the more events they generate, the higher your Mixpanel pricing goes. This can create uncomfortable conversations when your analytics budget scales faster than your revenue.
If Mixpanel pricing has you concerned (whether it's the complexity, the cost, or the scaling concerns), there's a better option for many use cases.

Unlike Mixpanel's event-based pricing that can spiral, Seline keeps things predictable. You know exactly what you're paying, and it won't bankrupt you as you grow.
Simplicity is Seline's superpower.
Have you tried setting up Mixpanel? Defining events, configuring properties, building reports... it's a project in itself. Seline takes minutes to set up. Copy a script, paste it on your site, and you're tracking. The intuitive dashboard shows you everything important at a glance.
Another reason Seline beats Mixpanel pricing concerns: privacy-first analytics . Mixpanel tracks detailed user behavior, which means cookie consent headaches, GDPR compliance concerns, and privacy policy updates. Seline doesn't use cookies. No cookies, no consent banners, no compliance headaches.
But Seline isn't just simple, it's powerful where it counts:
Visitor Journeys: See exactly how users move through your website. Understand where they convert and where they drop off.

Funnel Analysis: Set up funnels to track conversion paths. Identify bottlenecks and optimize your user experience without the Mixpanel pricing complexity.
Real-Time Data: See what's happening on your site right now, not hours later.
Custom Events: Track the interactions that matter to your business, without worrying about per-event costs.
For most websites and SaaS products, Seline delivers the insights you need at a price that makes sense. Why pay Mixpanel pricing when you can get actionable analytics for a fraction of the cost?
